messages:
Sophie (Finance): Heads up — VendorBeta flagged a duplicate reserved capacity charge on invoice INV-2026-0452 for Feb 1–28. They were billed twice for region 'eu-west-2' due to region aliasing. Total contested = $12,410. Can we do a manual credit + goodwill? cc @Olivia

Matt (FinOps): Can you paste the invoice ID + billing line IDs? Also what's the recommended split: full refund vs goodwill?

Sophie (Finance): Invoice INV-2026-0452
Billing lines: BL-98762 (reserved capacity, eu-west-2), BL-98763 (reserved capacity, eu-west-2 - duplicate)
Attached evidence: usage export + query below.

Sophie (Finance): ```sql
SELECT count(*) as tokens, region, charge_id
FROM billing.events
WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-0452'
GROUP BY region, charge_id;
``` 
Results show duplicated charge_id for two lines, same usage IDs.

Raj (Billing Eng): Yep, saw the ingestion pipeline ticket (BILL-3347) — region aliasing produced duplicate ingestion for that customer on 2026-02-10. We already have a patch queued (deploy v1.9.3) but it doesn't retroactively dedupe.

Olivia (Revenue Ops): How much of the $12,410 is above our goodwill authority? Head of Fin approves up to $5k. Anything above needs controller sign-off.

Sophie (Finance): Proposed: manual credit of $7,410 to fully adjust the duplicate charge lines, plus $5,000 as goodwill ($12,410 total). We need Laura to approve the goodwill portion.

Laura (Head of Finance): I approve the $5,000 goodwill. For the $7,410 operational adjustment, confirm accounting code to use and who will create the credit memo. :thumbsup:

Matt (FinOps): I'll create credit memo CM-2026-089 and route to accounting (AR-ops). Accounting code: 6000-COGS-billing-adj. Will mark revenue contra entry and schedule for next AR batch.

Sophie (Finance): Thanks — please tag the customer and include a one-line note: "Manual billing credit applied for duplicate reserved capacity — goodwill included per Head of Finance approval."

Raj (Billing Eng): I'll run a dedupe backfill script for that invoice range and open a follow-up change request so the pipeline doesn't re-ingest duplicates. Backfill job id: dedupe-2026-02-10-01

billing-bot: Auto-note: Credit memo CM-2026-089 created by Matt (FinOps) — pending accounting approval.

Sophie (Finance): Perfect. Customer notified, they replied :heart: Thank you all.

Matt (FinOps): Closing thread once CM posts. Ping me if accounting rejects.
